kiki.kuri.say: Say the sentence you heard, just as it was
kiki.kuri.againNote: A sentence heard again can't take you up a step
kiki.kuri.miss.none: No voice came through. Move closer to the mic and try again
kiki.kuri.miss.denied: The mic isn't allowed. Allow it in the iPhone's Settings › Safari › Microphone
kiki.kuri.miss.capped: The server's speech recognition is done for today. See you tomorrow
kiki.kuri.miss.off: The server's speech recognition is resting right now
kiki.kuri.miss.unpaired: This iPhone isn't connected to the server yet
kiki.kuri.miss.network: The connection didn't work. Try again
kiki.kuri.miss.timeout: Recognition took too long. Try again
kiki.kuri.miss.oom: The iPhone ran out of memory. Close other apps and try again
kiki.kuri.miss.service-not-allowed: Safari's speech recognition isn't available. Pick Auto in Settings › Mic
kiki.kuri.miss.other: That didn't come through. Try again
kiki.kuri.unavailable: Speech recognition isn't available. Download its data in ききみみ's Settings › Mic
kiki.kuri.replayed: Heard again, so one more at this length
kiki.kuri.stay: Close! One more at this length
kiki.kuri.end: That's the end of the run
kiki.kuri.reachedNone: No sentence came through this time
kiki.kuri.private: Only you see this. Your record keeps just the time
kiki.kuri.host.long: Wow! You said the long ones too
kiki.kuri.host.some: Nice going! Let's make them a little longer each time
kiki.kuri.host.none: Saying it out loud is the first step. Let's try again
